A dream job in Maastricht at a sustainable company! 
You will be working in a friendly, collegial and professional team. You will receive a competitive salary and excellent fringe benefits..

In addition to stock management, visual merchandising and keeping track of sales figures, you will of course be involved in customer loyalty, personnel management and CRM.

Looking for an active warehouse job?

Returns
